articles.title: The New Oil Powers: Why Refineries, Not Reserves, Are Redrawing the Global Energy Map
articles.titleEn: The New Oil Powers: Why Refineries, Not Reserves, Are Redrawing the Global Energy Map
articles.summary: Crude oil is flowing through the Strait of Hormuz again, but diesel and jet fuel remain in short supply. Seven months after the outbreak of the Iran war, a new energy hierarchy is emerging: the countries that control spare refining capacity are gaining influence over global prices, trade routes and national energy security. Europe is discovering that access to crude oil means little when the world cannot produce enough of the fuels its economy actually needs. The New Oil Powers: Why Refineries, Not Reserves, Are Redrawing the Global Energy Map

articles.title: Iran attacks US bases in Gulf countries despite diplomatic efforts
articles.titleEn: Iran attacks US bases in Gulf countries despite diplomatic efforts
articles.summary: By Enas AlashrayNov 18 (Reuters) - Gulf countries said on Wednesday they intercepted missiles and drones from Iran and its Houthi allies in Yemen, after the United States had struckQeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz in an uptick of hostilities despite efforts to end the nine-month-old war.The back-and-forth attacks were a reminder of the hurdles facingdiplomatic efforts to end a war that has destabilised the Middle East, pushed up global energy prices and helped fuel the US voter anger that punished President Donald Trump's Republican Party in the November elections.

articles.title: Wholesale inflation faces a triple squeeze from fuel, food and metals in FY27: Report
articles.titleEn: Wholesale inflation faces a triple squeeze from fuel, food and metals in FY27: Report
articles.summary: India's wholesale inflation is currently anticipated to reach around 11 percent in FY27, surpassing earlier projections. Persistent pressures from energy and input costs alongside risks to food prices are significant factors. The report highlights that global commodity prices will greatly influence this inflation trajectory. A potential 25-basis-point rate hike by the Reserve Bank of India is also expected in December.
